disease_label_per_paper: Septic shock after kidney transplant caused by bloodstream Ralstonia mannitolilytica infection
presentation_summary: Live-related donor kidney transplantation after hemodialysis
Post-transplant tacrolimus, mycophenolate mofetil, and prednisone
Fever to 39.5 C with chills followed by septic shock
Ralstonia mannitolilytica ultimately identified by conventional blood culture
Inflammatory response was distorted: leukocytes and CRP were not proportionally high at shock time, while PCT was >200 ng/mL
